name: SiteWhy
tagline: Check a US data center site against the rules that can block it — and see why.
description: US data center site regulatory screener that explains why each rule applies: deterministic applicability, verified quotes, computed flips and a critic loop.

sponsor_tech.nvidia_usage: Lightning handles extraction for the county investigator; Ultra handles planning, synthesis (adjudication) and critique. Quote verification is deterministic code, not a model call. Every call goes through Nightshift with per-request model and receipt in model_trace.
sponsor_tech.meterless_usage: World Model (app/worldmodel.py) is the shared provenance-stamped rule/evidence graph with a per-run JSONL audit log; Markovian (app/markovian.py) drives the county investigation loop.
sponsor_tech.zetaris_usage: SITEWHY.moratoria (1,291 rows) and state legislation (440 rows) queried per run; DuckDB serves the same SQL when Zetaris is unreachable.

data: U.S. EIA Form 861 subset, Census geocoder/TIGERweb, HIFLD transmission lines (public domain)
specs: Meterless World Model and Markovian engine specs (Apache-2.0)
